alternatives_considered.reasoning: A second workflow would duplicate change detection, credentials, folder resolution, and retry behavior already implemented by the resume-tailor deployment.

decisions.title: Python Baseline and Documentation Ownership Split
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: Operator documentation described an earlier pipeline, Python versions were hardcoded in GitHub Actions, and the README directory-map hook drifted from its installer. First-time Windows setup and day-to-day operation needed a single verified baseline and a clear document split.
drivers: Pin one Python version for local .venv and GitHub Actions via .python-version.
Keep setup.md as clone-to-validation bootstrap, including human locked-identity population.
Keep README.md as the owner-operator manual for current skills, runbooks, and Mermaid workflows.
Prevent two pre-commit implementations from drifting.
If Python 3.14 cannot install or pass runtime validation, fall back by changing only .python-version to 3.12.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Enforce Python via .python-version (3.14 retained after local install and smoke validation), ignore .venv/, point Actions at python-version-file, split setup.md vs README.md, and install hooks by copying the canonical pre-commit.ps1 plus wrapper.
decision_outcome.justification: A version file removes duplicated 3.12 pins. Verified 3.14 with existing requirement sets plus mcp[cli]==1.29.1, mcp-server-office==0.2.0, and lxml>=6.0.1, so fallback to 3.12 was not required. Setup owns bootstrap and identity fill; README owns operations. The hook installer copies files instead of embedding a second hook body.
implications: .github/workflows/ci.yml, cd-main.yml, and job-search-pull.yml read .python-version.
If a future 3.14 break occurs, change only .python-version to 3.12, recreate .venv, and rerun the same checks.
setup.md is the Windows bootstrap and locked-identity fill guide; README.md is the operator manual and does not duplicate setup.
scripts/set-up-scripts/pre-commit-update-script.ps1 copies canonical hook files into .git/hooks/.
The README directory map lives in a collapsible appendix and omits .venv, caches, fixtures, sandbox children, and individual test files.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep hardcoded python-version: 3.12 in each workflow
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Three workflow files would continue to drift from local runtime.

alternatives_considered.option: Fall back to 3.12 immediately without attempting 3.14
alternatives_considered.reasoning: 3.14 installed and passed import, MCP list_tools, and lxml/python-docx checks.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep a second hook body inside the update script
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Embedded copies diverge from scripts/set-up-scripts/pre-commit.ps1.

alternatives_considered.option: Combine setup and operator docs in README.md
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Bootstrap, secrets, and identity fill are a different audience than daily orchestrator and tailor runbooks.

decisions.title: Rename GitHub Repository to job-forge
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: The repository was created under a product-specific name while the project scope expanded beyond LinkedIn-specific automation. Live clone instructions, Greenhouse User-Agent branding, and test fixtures still referenced the old repository name.
drivers: Rename the GitHub repository to job-forge and retarget local origin.
Update setup.md clone path and directory name for new operators.
Rebrand the Greenhouse fetch User-Agent from linkedin-job-search-poc/1.0 to job-forge-job-search/1.0.
Align job-search test pr_url fixtures with the new repository slug.
Preserve GitHub redirects from the previous name and avoid rewriting historical ledger or deployed-plan URLs.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Rename the GitHub repository to job-forge, update origin URL, setup.md clone instructions, fetch_jobs.py User-Agent, and job-search test pr_url fixtures; record explicit non-goals for product LinkedIn references, historical shipped URLs, guardrails identity files, and the local workspace folder name.
decision_outcome.justification: GitHub rename with redirect keeps existing PR and Actions URLs reachable. Only live identity and operator-facing references need updating; LinkedIn-the-product mentions, approved-jobs.json pr_url values, deployed plans, defect records, and locked guardrails remain unchanged because they are not repository branding.
implications: origin points to https://github.com/atroberts06/job_forge.git.
setup.md clone block uses job_forge for clone URL and Set-Location.
fetch_jobs.py User-Agent is job-forge-job-search/1.0.
Job-search test fixtures use example/job-forge pr_url strings.
Historical approved-jobs.json pr_url, .cursor/plans/deployed/, and .ai/history/defects/ URLs are not rewritten.
Product LinkedIn references (contact URL, locked-linkedin-profile-template.md, InMail text) are unchanged.
Local folder rename is performed by the operator after merge; the agent cannot rename the active workspace.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep the previous repository name and update documentation only
alternatives_considered.reasoning: The repository name would continue to misrepresent project scope for new clones and external integrations.

alternatives_considered.option: Rewrite all historical pr_url and deployed-plan GitHub links
alternatives_considered.reasoning: GitHub redirects preserve old URLs; rewriting shipped ledger and plan history adds churn without operational benefit.

alternatives_considered.option: Rename local workspace folder automatically
alternatives_considered.reasoning: The agent cannot rename the directory it is running in; the operator renames after closing Cursor.

decisions.title: Dual-OS Bootstrap with Canonical POSIX Hook
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: First-time setup and operator docs were Windows/PowerShell only. The Git pre-commit wrapper invoked powershell.exe, which blocks clone-to-validation on macOS.
drivers: Document bash and PowerShell install paths without maintaining two directory-map implementations.
Keep existing .ps1 launchers for Windows operators.
Allow Git on macOS and Git for Windows to run the same hook body.
Avoid calling powershell.exe from the POSIX hook.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Canonical POSIX pre-commit rebuilds the README directory map; pre-commit.ps1 is a thin bash wrapper; setup.md and README.md use dual fences only where commands differ; bash is added to the installed toolkit alongside powershell.
decision_outcome.justification: ADR-035 rejected a second hook body. One POSIX script plus a thin PowerShell wrapper keeps Windows usable and makes macOS install work. Dual docs cover venv, MCP binary, hook install, and Drive env vars without duplicating portable python/git/gh commands.
implications: scripts/set-up-scripts/pre-commit is the directory-map implementation; install-hooks.sh and pre-commit-update-script.ps1 copy it with pre-commit.ps1 into .git/hooks/.
setup.md is macOS and Windows bootstrap; README.md remains the operator manual.
Dashboard start is serve.py via serve-dashboard.sh or serve-dashboard.ps1.
core-architecture.mdc lists bash and powershell.
pull-jobs.ps1 is unchanged and is not an authoritative rebuild path.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep PowerShell as the hook body and require PowerShell on macOS
alternatives_considered.reasoning: The POSIX wrapper already exists; calling powershell.exe is the macOS install break.

alternatives_considered.option: Maintain full bash and PowerShell copies of the directory-map rebuild
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Two hook bodies drift, which ADR-035 already rejected.

alternatives_considered.option: Replace PowerShell docs and delete .ps1 files
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Windows operators keep PowerShell wrappers and documented blocks where paths differ.

decisions.title: Cross-Platform companies.json Catalog for job search pull
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: Greenhouse board tokens lived in greenhouse/boards.json. That file could not represent multiple ingest sources per company, industry tags, or a future cross-platform catalog without duplicating criteria and puller inputs.
drivers: Replace per-platform boards.json with a job-search root companies.json catalog.
Two source slots per company (ats and company) with independent enabled flags.
industries[] on the company row for later vertical (more companies per industry) and horizontal (more industries) discovery.
Point the existing Greenhouse pull at enabled ats rows with platform greenhouse and a non-empty board_token.
Park at-scale discovery, detect_ats, two-phase fetch, and local/VM scheduling as Phase 2.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Add COMPANIES_FILE to the locked job-search schema; git mv greenhouse/boards.json to .ai/history/job-search/companies.json; fetch_jobs.py reads pullable Greenhouse ats sources from that catalog and ignores industries[] and the company slot.
decision_outcome.justification: The catalog is the missing company/board list without changing pull cadence or inventing a discovery pipeline. Industry tags are stored now so a later session can groom industry-scoped ingest. GitHub Actions remains the Phase 1 pull host for the current one-board catalog.
implications: companies.json is the source of truth for which Greenhouse boards to pull.
fetch_jobs.py fails closed on schema/semantic catalog errors or zero pullable Greenhouse ats sources.
Dashboard discoverPlatforms skips companies.json so it is not treated as a platform folder.
CI and CD validate companies.json when it changes.
Phase 2 (parked): local/VM scheduled discovery and job pull at scale; discover_greenhouse.py; detect_ats.py; per-platform puller rename; two-phase fetch; industry/locality-scoped discovery grooming.
Product LinkedIn references and HTML listing scrape remain out of scope (ADR-007).

alternatives_considered.option: Keep greenhouse/boards.json and add industries there
alternatives_considered.reasoning: A platform-local boards list cannot hold two ingest slots or a cross-platform company identity.

alternatives_considered.option: Ship URL-index discovery and GHA all-board pull in the same change
alternatives_considered.reasoning: At-scale harvest does not fit current GitHub Actions pricing; that work is Phase 2 on a local or VM scheduler.

alternatives_considered.option: Filter the daily pull by industries[] now
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Phase 1 only relocates the board list. Industry-scoped pull is a later grooming session.

decisions.title: Required nullable posted_at on locked job objects
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: Listing age was not a first-class field on jobs.json. Pull date and status timestamps do not represent when the employer posted the role, so newer openings could not be prioritized over older ones.
drivers: Store posting age as YYYY-MM-DD or null on every job object.
Parse source dates at ingest; never invent from updated_at or pulled_at.
Backfill historical Greenhouse pulls with null.
SerpApi relative chips and Greenhouse first_published/created_at are the parse sources.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Add required posted_at (YYYY-MM-DD|null) to the locked job schema; shared parse_posted_at in greenhouse/normalize.py; merge keeps a prior date when the new pull parses null.
decision_outcome.justification: Posting age is an extra priority signal. Omitting the key when unknown would break additionalProperties:false consumers; treating updated_at or pull date as posted would invent chronology.
implications: Every job object must include posted_at.
Historical greenhouse/src/*/jobs.json rows are backfilled to null.
Validators enforce null or YYYY-MM-DD.
Dashboard sort/column is not required for this schema change.

alternatives_considered.option: Omit posted_at when unknown
alternatives_considered.reasoning: additionalProperties:false plus inconsistent keys complicate validators and consumers.

alternatives_considered.option: Use updated_at or pulled_at as posted_at
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Those timestamps are mutation/pull time, not original post date.

decisions.title: Compartmentalized Data Ingestion Pipelines
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: ADR-013 assumed a single Greenhouse puller in a flat .github/scripts/job-search/ tree and one GHA job that fetch, validate, and commit in sequence. Additional ingest sources cannot share that layout without coupling failure domains and blocking independent development.
drivers: Compartmentalize extract, transform, load, and validate per platform.
Shared utilities live in common/; platform entry scripts are named fetch_{platform}_jobs.py.
job-search-pull.yml remains the single scheduled entry point.
Platform jobs upload artifacts; one commit job pushes combined results to main.
SerpApi failure or skip must not block a successful Greenhouse commit.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Platform folders under .github/scripts/job-search/ (common, greenhouse, serp-api) plus parallel GHA jobs greenhouse-pull, serpapi-pull, and commit-and-push
decision_outcome.justification: Single-platform assumptions in ADR-013 do not scale. Folder isolation enables independent tests and failure isolation while keeping one daily coordinated schedule and one push to main.
implications: PYTHONPATH includes .github/scripts/job-search so imports are common.* and greenhouse.*.
fetch_jobs.py is greenhouse/fetch_greenhouse_jobs.py.
write_analysis_stubs.py --platform selects the sandbox under .ai/history/job-search/{platform}/.
workflow_dispatch platform=all|greenhouse|serpapi selects which ingest jobs run.
SerpApi fetch is a skip placeholder until the SerpApi Jobs POC (child 2).
Direct-to-main validated commit behavior from ADR-013 is retained by the commit-and-push job.
Sandbox data layout under .ai/history/job-search/{platform}/ is unchanged (ADR-007). Criteria remain centralized in locked-job-search-criteria.json (ADR-009).
stamp_deployed_ledger.py loads scripts/ci/common.py by file path so it is not shadowed by the job-search common package.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep a flat script directory and add sequential SerpApi steps to the single pull job
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Couples platform failures, blocks parallel development, and keeps Greenhouse-named fetch_jobs.py as a false shared entrypoint.

alternatives_considered.option: One GHA workflow file per platform with independent commits to main
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Multiple daily pushes race on main; a final commit job preserves one coordinated snapshot.

decisions.title: Multi-id locked job-search criteria envelope and SerpApi Google Jobs POC
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: ADR-009 put one filter object in locked-job-search-criteria.json for every puller. SerpApi Google Jobs request params do not match Greenhouse title/location filters, and tuning Google Jobs must not rewrite Greenhouse criteria.
drivers: One criteria file, many id records (jsc_001 greenhouse, jsc_002 google_jobs).
SerpApi puller in serpapi-pull GHA job with Environment production SERPAPI_API_KEY.
jsc_002.max_searches caps billed google_jobs HTTP requests (not jobs kept). Pagination still at most one extra page per query. Monthly free-plan budget from account.json.
Catalog source=serpapi with ats.enabled=false for detected boards.
job-analysis must not read this file.

decision_outcome.selected_option: criteria[] envelope; fetch_greenhouse_jobs loads jsc_001; fetch_serpapi_jobs loads jsc_002; QUOTA_STOP skips SerpApi without failing Greenhouse commit.
decision_outcome.justification: Keeps a single locked file while isolating pipeline-specific request fields. Parallel GHA jobs already isolate failure domains (ADR-040).
implications: jsc_001 filter values stay unchanged; only pipeline is added.
jsc_002 owns Google Jobs wire fields (search_query, location, date_posted, industry_query, max_searches, etc.). Empty location.include is nationwide regardless of include_remote.
Orchestrator/job-analysis remain Greenhouse-only for this POC.
companies.json may gain serpapi-sourced rows with enabled=false until manually enabled.

alternatives_considered.option: Per-platform criteria files under .ai/history/job-search/
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Splits the locked SoT and complicates guardrail validation.

alternatives_considered.option: OR-join all search_query terms into one SerpApi q
alternatives_considered.reasoning: One billed search per include entry is the SoT fan-out and keeps result quality per title.

decisions.title: Multi-platform analysis and tailor queue minting
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: After SerpApi ingest, stubs land under .ai/history/job-search/serpapi/ but generate-analysis-queue.py and generate-tailor-queue.py hardcoded PLATFORM=greenhouse. Claim/copy/consume fell back to greenhouse when platform was missing. Orchestrator and job-analysis skills still described Greenhouse-only pickup.
drivers: Queue every eligible sandbox that has src/, including serpapi and future platforms.
One queue file equals one platform; envelope platform stays a single required field.
No shared discover_platforms helper; each generator scans sandboxes inline.
Fail-closed if queue platform is missing or empty; do not default to greenhouse.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Inline src/ sandbox scan in generate-analysis-queue.py and generate-tailor-queue.py; per-platform queue files; optional --platform filter; fail-closed platform on claim/copy/consume
decision_outcome.justification: ADR-041 left orchestrator/job-analysis Greenhouse-only for the SerpApi POC. Pickup must follow ingest without a shared catalog-discovery module (child 4 owns Greenhouse companies.json upsert separately).
implications: Default mint walks .ai/history/job-search/{platform}/ where src/ exists; skip queue and dashboard.
Optional --platform (comma list or repeatable) limits discovery; unknown names fail-closed.
--job-id resolves the sandbox from the id prefix (serpapi:... -> serpapi).
max_jobs_per_agent batches within a platform; batch_number restarts per platform.
consume_analysis_queue.py, claim_tailor_in_progress.py, and consume_tailor_queue.py require a non-empty platform.
purge_dated_src.py already walks all platform dirs (skip queue, dashboard); companies.json is a file and is not a sandbox.
Dashboard discoverPlatforms probes src/ and does not inject greenhouse when the tree is empty.
Orchestrator validates each existing {platform}/approved-jobs.json after consume, not only greenhouse.

alternatives_considered.option: Shared common/platforms.py discover_platforms used by ingest and queue minting
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Ingest pipelines own unique catalog write logic (child 4). Queue minting must not centralize discovery for reuse by Greenhouse upsert.

alternatives_considered.option: Mixed-platform jobs in a single queue file
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Would change the queue envelope schema. Analysis and tailor skills process one file with one platform path.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep silent greenhouse fallback when platform is missing
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Would write SerpApi consume/claim/copy onto the greenhouse ledger.

decisions.title: TalentBrew company-slot ingest is local Windows
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: Capital One careers is Phenom TalentBrew at ~1758 live jobs. That scale does not belong on GitHub Actions billing (ADR-038 Phase 2). Listing identity and Workday requisition are different objects on the same page.
drivers: Company-slot ingest, not ats.platform=talentbrew/phenom.
Local Windows host with pull-jobs.ps1 commit/push to main after merge, matching GHA commit-and-push.
Listing PK is TalentBrew posting seq; Workday requisition is optional workday_requisition_id on $defs.job.
No new Python packages. No GHA TalentBrew job.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Local TalentBrew puller under .github/scripts/job-search/talentbrew/ writing .ai/history/job-search/talentbrew/src/{date}/jobs.json; jsc_003; catalog company.enabled; optional workday_requisition_id
decision_outcome.justification: Public search-jobs/results JSON plus detail JSON-LD is the vendor search API. Workday CXS is a different id space. SerpApi is quota-bound aggregator quality.
implications: id is talentbrew:{board_token}:{source_job_id} with digits-only listing seq.
workday_requisition_id is correlation/audit only; merge and close-missing stay keyed on listing id.
Greenhouse and SerpApi omit workday_requisition_id. TalentBrew always writes the key.
Scheduled JobForge-TalentBrew-Pull runs daily 08:00 UTC after GHA 07:00 UTC.
Ingest code ships on a feature-branch PR; scheduled commit/push of jobs.json is direct-to-main after merge.

alternatives_considered.option: Workday CXS as the ingest source
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Different site and id space; POST-only; empty lists when limit != 20.

alternatives_considered.option: GitHub Actions TalentBrew job
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Page volume and 1.5s pacing exceed ADR-038 Phase 2 GHA billing posture.

alternatives_considered.option: Use Workday requisition as source_job_id
alternatives_considered.reasoning: R… fails locked digits-only source_job_id; recast postings would collapse distinct listing rows.

decisions.title: Web research moves from job-analysis to resume-tailor
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: job_analysis_policy_001 owned unlimited WebSearch/WebFetch per listing. Analysis still maps every queued job, including rejects, so live research ran before qualification. Resume-tailor already runs only on approved (or manually chosen) roles and already writes company/compensation notes into engineering-log.md.
drivers: Analysis stays LLM mapping against locked evidence. No live web.
Live WebSearch/WebFetch run only in resume-tailor, after qualification.
Research caps stay in locked-agent-policies.json. 0/null skip that tool; omitted/negative halt the owning skill.
Queue-invoked tailor consumes analysis from the tailor-request row, not analyses/*.json.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Remove research from job_analysis_policy_001. Add research under resume_tailor_policy_001 with max_web_searches_per_job 5 and max_web_fetches_per_job 3. Analysis always persists external_context.decision_impact none and sources []. Company and NYC/NJ compensation research is audit-only in the tailor engineering log and must not change the queue-row decision.
decision_outcome.justification: Rejected listings should not pay for web research. Caps replace ADR-026 unlimited analysis research. Tailor already owns the human-readable research sink. Analysis sidecar schema stays required and empty.
implications: job-analysis reads execution only. Absence of research on that record is not a halt.
resume-tailor reads execution and research. Fan-out stays serial.
Queue-invoked tailor mints engineering-log sections 1-3 from the queue row via upsert_engineering_log.py, then fills research placeholders, then writes section 4.
Do not rewrite ADR-026 or ADR-029 selected_option text. This ADR supersedes research placement only.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep unlimited analysis research (ADR-026 first-ship)
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Burns search/fetch on jobs that will be rejected before tailor.

alternatives_considered.option: Thin sidecar / first-fatal knockout instead of full analysis mapping
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Qualification still needs experience, named-tech skills, and constraints against locked evidence.

alternatives_considered.option: Unlimited tailor research
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Approved roles still need a per-job cap. First-ship is 5 searches and 3 fetches.

decisions.title: Queue-invoked tailor slugs always suffix source_job_id (extends ADR-011 nested sandbox)
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: Sandbox and feature-branch identity was kebab_case(company)+kebab_case(title) only. Same display titles (Capital One generic reqs; SerpAPI recrawl ids) fail-closed at P2-X1 after orchestrator claim, so distinct listings never got a resume.
drivers: Queue mint writes company_slug and position_slug. Ledger PK stays id.
Always-suffix for generate-tailor-queue.py (full mint and --job-id). Collision-only suffix rejected.
Suffix token is source_job_id only. Never workday_requisition_id (R*).
source_job_id longer than 10 characters uses the last 10; shorter values use the full id.
Manual resume-tailor (no queue) keeps unsuffixed parent-folder slugs.
Do not change kebab_case() itself (SerpAPI board tokens).
Do not rewrite unsuffixed winner folders. Failed collision rows remint onto the new convention as a one-time ops step.

decision_outcome.selected_option: generate-tailor-queue.py always writes company_slug=kebab_case(company) and position_slug=kebab_case(title)-{source_job_id suffix}. Queue-invoked resume-tailor honors those slugs and does not re-kebab title. P2-X1 stays fail-closed when that sandbox is bound to a different id. Missing source_job_id fail-closes mint. SerpAPI recrawl skip is out of scope.
decision_outcome.justification: ADR-011 nested {company}/{position} is still the sandbox architecture. Title-only position folders cannot express concurrent same-title listings. Always-suffix on the queue-invoked position segment keeps that layout, avoids same-batch occupancy races, and leaves historical unsuffixed winner PRs and manual drop-JD folders untouched.
implications: ADR-011 layout is unchanged: one feature branch maps to one two-segment sandbox .ai/history/resume-tailor/{company_slug}/{position_slug}/. The position segment is still kebab-case; queue-invoked mint appends -{source_job_id suffix}.

Dual convention: (1) Queue-invoked / --job-id mint always suffixes position_slug from source_job_id (last 10 characters if longer than 10; else full). Never workday_requisition_id. (2) Manual resume-tailor (no queue) keeps legacy unsuffixed kebab_case(company)+kebab_case(title) from parent folders of job-description.md. (3) Historical unsuffixed folders and open winner PRs are not rewritten; DEF-002 losers remint onto the suffixed convention.
Queue-invoked tailor reads company_slug and position_slug from the queue row. Do not re-kebab listing title. P2-X1 stays fail-closed when that sandbox is bound to a different id.
validate_tailor_request.py requires company_slug and position_slug on every queue row.
claim_tailor_in_progress.py stays file-level.
SKIP_STATUSES still includes failed; remint of collision losers is a one-time ledger reset to approved, not a mint flag.
Do not rewrite ADR-011 or ADR-028 selected_option text. This ADR extends nested sandbox identity for queue-invoked runs only.

alternatives_considered.option: Collision-only suffix when company+title is already bound
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Same-batch distinct reqs share a title before either sandbox exists; occupancy is not on main disk.

alternatives_considered.option: Suffix with workday_requisition_id (R*)
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Workday id is not listing identity (ADR-043). SerpAPI and Greenhouse omit the key.

alternatives_considered.option: Dedupe SerpAPI recrawls / location clones at ingest or mint
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Out of scope for DEF-002. Distinct job_ids each get a unique suffixed sandbox.

alternatives_considered.option: Change kebab_case() globally
alternatives_considered.reasoning: SerpAPI normalize uses kebab_case for company/board tokens.

alternatives_considered.option: Add a third sandbox segment or rewrite historical unsuffixed folders to always-suffix
alternatives_considered.reasoning: ADR-011 two-segment company/position layout and CI folder resolution stay. Manual drop-JD and already-open winner PRs keep unsuffixed paths.

decisions.title: SerpAPI close is manual; close-wins stays ATS-board only (amends ADR-022)
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: ADR-022 close-missing treated any id absent from today's jobs.json as closed on the nearest prior file. SerpAPI Google Jobs is a ranked, billed, non-deterministic result set, not a complete board snapshot. Auto-close false-closed live listings, skipped analysis, and dropped dashboard join rows.
drivers: Board snapshot vs search: Greenhouse and TalentBrew today-file absence is board-gone. SerpAPI absence is not proof the posting was taken down.
Manual close only: SerpAPI status closed is a human last-seen JSON edit. No pull-time auto-close. No close CLI this cut.
Live file shape unchanged: today's SerpAPI jobs.json stays this-pull listings only. Do not copy yesterday's live rows into today.
Analysis agents must not invent closed (unchanged).

decision_outcome.selected_option: Remove close_missing_on_prior from fetch_serpapi_jobs.py. Greenhouse and TalentBrew keep ADR-022. SerpAPI closed is a human edit of the last-seen dated row. One-shot DEF-005 reopen rewrites existing SerpAPI closed rows from sidecar (init stub revision 0 → new; filled → active; missing sidecar left closed).
decision_outcome.justification: Close-wins is a fact about ATS board presence. Google Jobs result-set churn is not board presence. Keeping today's file as this-pull listings avoids mixing history into the live join. Last-seen closed still skips generate-analysis-queue.py, so a documented human edit is enough to retire a listing.
implications: fetch_serpapi_jobs.py prints Closed: 0 / SUMMARY closed=0 after a successful pull. Prior dated files are not rewritten at pull time.
Do not rewrite ADR-022 selected_option. This ADR narrows close-wins to Greenhouse and TalentBrew.
job-data-model.json closed notes distinguish ATS CI close-missing from SerpAPI human close.
Human SerpAPI close: in the most recent dated jobs.json that contains the id, set status=closed and stamp status_updated_at now. Do not invent closed during analysis.
One-shot reopen of historically false-closed SerpAPI rows is part of DEF-005, not a reusable script.
DEF-004 widget title fallback remains required: rolled-off ids still leave today's live file.

alternatives_considered.option: Copy yesterday's live SerpAPI rows into today so close-missing never fires
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Today's file would mix this-pull results with stale listings and would keep close-wins on a non-authoritative snapshot.

alternatives_considered.option: Ship a SerpAPI close CLI this cut
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Human last-seen JSON edit is enough. generate-analysis-queue.py already skips last-seen closed.

alternatives_considered.option: Leave historically false-closed SerpAPI rows closed
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Default analysis mint would keep skipping last-seen closed stubs.

decisions.title: Dashboard widget titles index all dated src files; live G9 join stays latest-src only (extends ADR-007, ADR-008, ADR-046)
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: P2-D1 execution widgets resolve Title from the G9 live join only. The join reads {platform}/src/{latest-date}/jobs.json. SerpAPI daily files drop listings Google no longer returns (ADR-046). Ledger rows for those ids still appear in PR ready / in progress / failed with a blank Title.
drivers: Live join contract unchanged: main table lists new|active rows from the latest dated file only. Do not add rolled-off or closed jobs back onto the join.
Widgets are ledger-scoped: they must remain readable after a listing leaves today's live file.
Dashboard stays read-only POC: no writes to ledgers or src/.
Do not invent listing titles. Prefer a previously ingested jobs.json title when that file is still on disk.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Dashboard builds a display-only title index from every remaining dated {platform}/src/*/jobs.json. Latest non-empty title/company for an id wins. The G9 live join still uses only the latest dated file and still skips closed. Widgets call this index when the id is absent from the live join.
decision_outcome.justification: ADR-046 keeps today's SerpAPI file as this-pull listings. That is correct for presence. Execution widgets are not a presence board; they show ledger work that often outlives the live file. Walking remaining dated src files reuses ingested titles without changing pull shape or approvedJob.
implications: Do not rewrite ADR-007, ADR-008, or ADR-046 selected_option. This ADR extends dashboard display only.
job-data-model.json documents dashboard_widgets title resolution and that closed/rolled-off ids stay off the live join.
Empty title strings are not written into jobs.json to fix widgets.
When every dated src file that held the id is purged, ADR-048 slug/placeholder fallback still yields a non-empty Title cell.

alternatives_considered.option: Add rolled-off ledger ids back onto the G9 live join
alternatives_considered.reasoning: The main table is a live presence board. Mixing closed or yesterday-only SerpAPI rows would reopen ADR-046 live-file shape.

alternatives_considered.option: Copy yesterday's live SerpAPI rows into today so titles stay on the join
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Rejected in ADR-046. Widget display must not force stale listings into the live file.

decisions.title: Widget title slug fallback is display-only; approvedJob stays id-only (extends ADR-008, ADR-045)
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: A historical src title index (ADR-047) still fails after dated src/ purge. approvedJob has no title or company (additionalProperties false). Using sandbox_path / feature_branch kebabs as a new identity SoT would reopen DEF-002.
drivers: Title column must stay non-empty for every ledger widget row.
Do not change locked approvedJob this cut. Denormalized title/company is optional later and needs schema, validators, and consume writers.
sandbox_path and feature_branch remain tailor identity (ADR-045). Widget kebab-to-display is presentation only.
Never invent a listing title that was not ingested or derived from an existing slug.

decision_outcome.selected_option: If ADR-047 has no title, widgets kebab-to-display the position segment of sandbox_path, else feature_branch after the feature/ prefix. If both are missing or empty, render the explicit placeholder (title unavailable). Do not persist title or company on approvedJob.
decision_outcome.justification: The ledger already stores the sandbox path from a successful or failed tailor claim. That string is enough for a human-readable cell after src purge. Treating it as display keeps ADR-045 identity rules intact and avoids a locked-schema change for a read-only dashboard.
implications: Resolution order is live join title, then any dated src title, then slug display, then (title unavailable).
Kebab-to-display is not listing identity and is not used by resume-tailor or generate-tailor-queue.py.
Do not change approvedJob.additionalProperties or add title/company without a later locked-schema ADR.
Do not rewrite ADR-008 or ADR-045 selected_option.

alternatives_considered.option: Persist title and company on approvedJob at consume time
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Locked additionalProperties: false plus consume/validator/test churn. Not required while dated src files or sandbox slugs remain.

alternatives_considered.option: Leave the Title cell blank when src is gone
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Widgets stay unreadable after purge. Acceptance requires a non-blank fallback.

alternatives_considered.option: Treat sandbox kebab as a new source of truth for tailoring identity
alternatives_considered.reasoning: DEF-002 / ADR-045: listing id is the PK; slugs are sandbox path segments only.

decisions.title: Variable-length printed resume is consecutive master prefix 5-10 (extends ADR-006, ADR-015, ADR-021)
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: The locked Word template and CI chronology check assumed exactly five printed roles matching the full master template. Older locked evidence (keys 6-10) could not deepen tenure or industry coverage without inventing facts or breaking existing five-role sandboxes.
drivers: Prefix contract: printed roles are exactly consecutive master keys 1..N. No skipping, reordering, or arbitrary title matching.
Default N=5. Deepen to the smallest N in 6..10 only when older locked evidence closes a JD required or preferred gap not covered by 1..5.
Keys 11 (Independent Consulting) and 12 (Community Technology Center) stay off the resume and may be cited only in engineering-log.md.

One-time protected-file authorization: locked-resume-template.docx, locked-resume-master-template.md, resume-tailor/SKILL.md, and formatting-rules.mdc may be edited for this implementation only. Locked companies, titles, dates, skills, accomplishments, and metrics stay immutable.
CI compatibility: existing five-role sandboxes remain valid after the master grows to ten roles. No backfill or document regeneration.
Variable prefix tokens stay JOB_HISTORY_1..JOB_HISTORY_10. Adding slots 6-10 does not rename keys 1-5.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Ten Word/master slots; filler and CI validate a bounded consecutive prefix 5-10; unused N+1..10 paragraphs are removed; Word bolds the theme through the first colon
decision_outcome.justification: A bounded prefix keeps chronology locked while letting older retail/POS evidence print only when it closes a real JD gap. Exact full-master equality would force every sandbox to regenerate ten roles. Title-matched subsets would allow skipping Northstar Retail or printing keys 11-12.
implications: Do not rewrite ADR-006, ADR-015, or ADR-021 selected_option text. This ADR extends printed-length and chronology validation only.
fill_resume.py requires 1-5 themed bullets per included role and aborts on missing theme colon, N<5, N>10, gaps, reordering, or keys 11-12.
CI validate_resume_tailor_artifacts.py compares tailored headers to master[:N], not the full ten-role master.
derive_template.py must emit the complete slot 1-10 token inventory so re-derivation cannot regress the locked Word template to five slots.
Experience may grow past one page. No hard two-page limit or page-fit pass.
Normal resume-tailor runs still never write .ai/guardrails/. The protected-file exception is this implementation cut only.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep exact full-master equality after growing the master to ten roles
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Would invalidate every existing five-role sandbox and force backfill of older roles that do not close a JD gap.

alternatives_considered.option: Allow title-matched subsets or skipped middle jobs
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Breaks locked chronology. A sixth printed role must always be Northstar Retail / Application Development Systems Analyst.

alternatives_considered.option: Print keys 11-12 when they appear to close a gap
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Those roles are excluded from the resume. They remain log-only evidence.

decisions.title: Analysis Queue Listing Snapshot for Qualification Parity
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: Job-analysis qualification required reading the full job description and metadata from last-seen dated jobs.json files, which are large (~780 KB). Because the analysis queue file was id-only, agents were incentivized to create ad-hoc python helper scripts and dump temporary extract files (_tmp_*) to disk (DEF-006). Meanwhile, resume-tailor already used a snapshot payload pattern where listing fields are minted directly onto the queue file.
drivers: Parity: Bring analysis-request queue files to architectural parity with tailor-request queue files by minting normalized listing fields on the queue row.
Clean working tree: Eliminate the need for agents to invent extract scripts or persist temporary files (_tmp_*) during analysis runs.
Source of Truth: Establish the invoke queue file row as the job description Source of Truth for the analysis agent, making last-seen dated jobs.json mint-only.
Schema governance: Keep the queue schema governed by the Python validator (validate_analysis_request.py) without modifying locked-job-search-data-model.json.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Mint analysis-request rows with snapshot listing fields (company, title, location, work_location_type, url, description_text); queue row is analysis JD SoT; validator enforces non-empty fields and work_location_type enum
decision_outcome.justification: Snapshotting the 6 normalized listing fields onto queue rows aligns analysis with the proven resume-tailor queue pattern, removes file-size pressure on analysis agents, resolves DEF-006, and prevents repo pollution.
implications: generate-analysis-queue.py snapshots company, title, location, work_location_type, url, and description_text from the last-seen dated jobs.json, skipping jobs with missing/blank fields.
validate_analysis_request.py requires the six listing keys on all rows (pending and analysis_complete), enforcing non-empty strings and work_location_type enum (remote|hybrid|onsite|unknown).
job-analysis SKILL.md drops dated jobs.json from its Read allowlist; qualification consumes the queue row payload directly; status flipping to analysis_complete preserves listing keys.
Supersedes DEF-006's id-only queue constraint.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep id-only queue and add allowlisted print_last_seen_job.py helper
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Stdout capture is clunky, high token churn, and leaves the two agent queues architecturally divergent.

alternatives_considered.option: Nest full listing object under listing: {$defs.job}
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Unnecessary schema complexity and duplication of audit/raw fields.

alternatives_considered.option: Copy raw ATS payloads and listing status onto queue
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Prevents queue bloat and avoids collision between listing status and queue lifecycle status.

decisions.title: Accordion last-page fill re-evaluation for N>5 resumes (extends ADR-049)
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: ADR-049 lets the printed resume deepen to a consecutive master prefix N in 6..10 when older locked evidence closes a JD gap, and explicitly declared no page-fit pass. In practice, deepening to N>5 can leave the final page sparse (the committed Authentic Brands N=7 resume fills only ~42% of its last page), which reads as an unfinished document even though every printed bullet is locked evidence.
drivers: Accordion-only scope: the pass runs only when the accordion already pushed printed roles past the default five (N>5). Default N=5 resumes are untouched.

Deterministic, approximate measurement: after tailored-resume.md is written and the .docx is filled, estimate the last page fill as a fraction of usable page height (page_height minus top/bottom margins from the template sectPr) using the existing twip-width approach.

Gap-only remedy: additions must be locked evidence that closes a JD required or preferred gap and adds thematic relevance. Never pad. If no gap-closing evidence remains, ship as-is and log the rationale.
Advisory, not a gate: the estimator prints the fill % on every run and never hard-fails CI or the filler, because underfill can be legitimately unavoidable under the gap-only rule.
One-time protected-file authorization to edit .cursor/skills/resume-tailor/SKILL.md for this implementation only. No changes to locked companies, titles, dates, skills, accomplishments, or metrics.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Add an advisory scripts/resume-docx/page_fill.py estimator (page_count, last_page_fill_ratio); fill_resume.py prints the last-page fill line after writing the docx; resume-tailor SKILL.md runs a gap-only loop-until when N>5 and the last page is below ~65%, targeting ~75% usable last-page height
decision_outcome.justification: A deterministic twip-based estimate cleanly discriminates the underfilled N=7 accordion case (~42%) from well-filled N=5 resumes (~75-96% on committed sandboxes) without Word/COM or PDF pagination. Keeping it advisory preserves the gap-only guardrail: the loop stops when locked gap-closing evidence is exhausted rather than inventing filler.
implications: Reverses ADR-049 decision_outcome implication "Experience may grow past one page. No hard two-page limit or page-fit pass." There is still no hard two-page cap and no CI gate; the page-fill pass is an advisory re-evaluation only.

scripts/resume-docx/page_fill.py reads section page/margin geometry and the body table row/cell widths, estimates wrapped-line height per paragraph (regular-weight twip map for body bullets; bold map reused for headers), and returns (page_count, last_page_fill_ratio). Target 75% of usable last-page height; trigger re-evaluation below ~65% (tolerance band).
fill_resume.py main() prints the advisory fill line after "wrote {dest}"; estimator failure is caught and never fails the fill. The fill behavior itself is unchanged.

resume-tailor SKILL.md: when N>5 and last-page fill < ~65% and gap-closing locked evidence remains, first add a relevant locked bullet to an already-printed role (role stays within 1-5 bullets), else extend N by the next consecutive master role only if it adds gap-closing evidence; regenerate, re-fill, re-estimate. Naturally bounded by max 10 roles and max 5 bullets/role. Record the assessment in engineering-log.md section 2 Accomplishment Selection Strategy.
Bullet-count guidance keeps target 3 and now explicitly allows up to 5 on a printed role when the extra bullet is gap-closing locked evidence that also improves last-page fill.

resume-data-model.json documents the advisory page-fill pass; CI runs scripts/resume-docx tests when scripts/resume-docx/ changes (existing 10-slot gate). Normal resume-tailor runs still never write .ai/guardrails/.

alternatives_considered.option: Word/COM or PDF-based exact pagination
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Requires Office automation or a PDF toolchain outside the documented CLI set, is slow, and adds a heavy dependency for what only needs an approximate advisory signal.

alternatives_considered.option: Hard two-page cap or CI gate on fill %

decisions.title: Greenhouse board token discovery, catalog upsert, and auto-enable of ATS pulls
decisions.author: IT Solution Architect

context.problem_statement: The public Greenhouse Job Board API requires a known {board_token} and has no directory endpoint. Catalog Greenhouse ingest only pulls ats.enabled=true rows (greenhouse_ats_boards()). Tokens today are manual (source=manual). There is no automated, criteria-driven way to discover new Greenhouse boards, write them into companies.json, and turn on the next scheduled ATS pull.
drivers: Local Windows scheduled task (same posture as TalentBrew / ADR-043); not a GitHub Actions job (Chrome session is on the user machine; discovery volume must not burn GHA minutes).
Session cookie scraped from Chrome Default and passed as --session-cookie; decrypt with stdlib ctypes (DPAPI + BCrypt AES-GCM); copy Cookie SQLite to a temp file while Chrome is open.
Targeted discovery via jsc_004 search chips (Cartesian product of search_term with non-empty filter chips), not a full MyGreenhouse crawl.
Catalog upsert is insert-new-only: early dedupe by company_id or existing ats.board_token; never mutate existing rows (including source=manual and prior SerpApi first-fill).

Probe after new-company selection: GET boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs. Reachable -> upsert with ats.enabled=true (auto-enables the next Greenhouse pull). Unreachable -> still upsert, ats.enabled=false (tracked, not pulled).

Discovery does not write jobs.json. Auto-enable is catalog-only: the next scheduled Greenhouse pull (fetch_greenhouse_jobs.py / GHA) reads newly enabled boards through greenhouse_ats_boards() and filters listings with jsc_001.

decision_outcome.selected_option: Local discover_greenhouse_boards.py + discover-boards.ps1. Chrome cookie -> Inertia search on my.greenhouse.io -> extract tokens -> early dedupe -> probe -> upsert new companies.json rows (ats.source=greenhouse_discovery). Probe pass auto-enables ATS (ats.enabled=true); probe fail inserts disabled.
decision_outcome.justification: MyGreenhouse is the only Greenhouse surface that lists jobs across customers. The public board API remains the ingest SoT once a token is known. Insert-new upsert plus probe-gated enabled keeps the ledger append-only, auto-wires reachable boards into the existing puller, and prevents the puller from hammering dead boards.
implications: Add jsc_004 to locked-job-search-criteria.json; fetch_greenhouse_jobs.py continues to load jsc_001 only. No puller code change is required for auto-enable.
New reachable boards appear on the next Greenhouse scheduled pull automatically because greenhouse_ats_boards() already selects ats.enabled is True and platform == greenhouse.
Missing/expired Chrome session: log and exit 0 (scheduled task skip, not a hard fail).
HTTP 429/503: retry up to 3 with exponential backoff; honor request_delay_ms.
Zero new companies: no git commit. New upserts: commit/push companies.json on main with a discovery summary (+N new boards (total M enabled)).
No new pip packages. Cookie crypto stays in ctypes.
Normal discovery runs still never write .ai/guardrails/ (criteria is configured once via jsc_004).

alternatives_considered.option: SerpAPI / Google site:job-boards.greenhouse.io dorking
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Billed, noisy, not chip-targeted, and already a separate ingest (ADR-041).

alternatives_considered.option: GitHub Actions discovery job
alternatives_considered.reasoning: No user Chrome session; GHA billing (ADR-038/043 posture).

alternatives_considered.option: Manual-only token entry and manual ats.enabled flips
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Does not scale; catalog has very few enabled Greenhouse boards.

alternatives_considered.option: Probe-then-skip-insert on 404
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Loses historical tracking of discovered-but-private boards.

alternatives_considered.option: Upsert/enable existing catalog rows
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Mutates human or SerpApi first-fill slots; ADR-054 upsert is new companies only.

alternatives_considered.option: Discovery writing jobs.json directly
alternatives_considered.reasoning: Bypasses jsc_001 listing filters and the existing Greenhouse ingest contract (ADR-040).
